subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should maintainers sponsor this cron timeline feature as a fresh or heavily rebased Control UI implementation on the current cron page?
rationale: The feature is user-visible and useful, but accepting it now requires product ownership plus a substantial rebase and scheduler/status correctness work that automation should not infer from a stale feature branch.

options.title: Request a fresh current-page PR
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and ask for a rebased implementation against ui/src/pages/cron/view.ts that preserves current cron contracts.

options.title: Adopt and repair this branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly sponsor the feature and own the port, status-contract preservation, scheduler accuracy, and i18n cleanup.

options.title: Defer the timeline feature
options.body: Leave the feature issue open as backlog and avoid treating this stale branch as the landing path.

recommendation.title: Request a fresh current-page PR
recommendation.body: Keep the linked issue open and ask for a rebased implementation against ui/src/pages/cron/view.ts that preserves current cron contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest combined signal across recent cron runtime and current cron UI routing history.
